title: Modular Tree
statement: Given a rooted tree of up to 2·10^5 nodes where node i has value a_i and modulus b_i up to 10^9, an operation replaces a node's value with (value + sum of its children's current values) mod b_i. The task is to find the maximum achievable total of all node values after any number of operations, which reduces to per-node gcd reachability computed bottom-up.
